caption: The drawing depicts a large, cylindrical preserve jar that is reddish-brown in color, occupying the central position on a flat, greenish-gray surface. The jar has a wide mouth with a thick, rounded lip and gently sloping shoulders that lead into a straight, tall body. In front of the base of the jar, there is a small red fruit, likely a cherry, along with a short brown stem and a couple of attached green leaves. The background behind the jar is plain and cream-colored, and at the top of the image, the text "LARGE PRESERVE JAR EARLY 19TH CENTURY" is written in capital letters.
title: Preserve Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
